scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
scripts.vercel-build: npx esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=api/index.js && npm run build --prefix client
